sensitivity.description: Post hoc diagnostic excluding news.google.com from both fixed matched-domain windows; not a corrected estimate and not a change to the screening algorithm.

editorialDecision: Hold the advertising-direction claim; publish this methods audit instead.
limitations: Measures keyword mentions in eligible news headlines, not AI adoption, transactions, demand, market share or business performance.
Purposive source sample; no statistical significance or population inference. Topics can overlap.
Exact normalized headlines and canonical URLs are deduplicated; paraphrased syndicated stories can remain.
Matched domains reduce source entry/exit effects; editorial output and retrospective relevance labels can still change.
Candidate means ready for source review, never permission to publish. Review primary sources and novelty before writing.
A source domain is the stored URL hostname, not necessarily the originating newsroom.
No complete story-origin clustering was performed. Do not label all aggregator records duplicates or assume they are independent.
The post hoc exclusion diagnoses sensitivity; it cannot establish a fall in advertising activity or sentiment.
privacy: Aggregate counts and original workflow only. No raw headlines, article bodies, database identifiers, customer rows, credentials or private provider lineage.

worksheet.purpose: Review a candidate trend before briefing a decision-maker
decisionRules: Keep the original calculation alongside any diagnostic; never silently replace it.
Resolve source origin and group shared reporting before calling reports independent.
Escalate a sign reversal or concentrated coverage for review rather than changing a commercial budget.
Use merchant outcomes for merchant-performance claims; headline volume cannot supply them.
